provenance: CLI argv template verbatim from contracts-S3.md C10; F-a (prompt must be the first argv after `claude`, before any variadic flag) from spike-P0-h.md ("Findings useful for the spec... F-a") and confirmed by spike-P0-h launch failures hf215c7a3 / launch 2 (--add-dir swallowed the positional prompt). Launcher stdin/stdout contract verbatim from C10.

cli.template: wt.exe -w new -d <cwd> claude "ctx-rotate:<nonce>" --add-dir <run dir> --permission-mode acceptEdits --settings <settings file>
cli.rule: the prompt is the first argv token after the literal "claude" token, before any variadic flag such as --add-dir
cli.bad_argv_regression_note: spike-P0-h hf215c7a3: --add-dir is variadic and swallows the positional prompt, so the successor starts with an empty prompt box and no hook fires; this is the exact regression F-a guards against
cli.fallback_when_wt_absent: powershell Start-Process claude with the same argv

single_window_guard.rule: more than one Cursor window has the directory open -> refuse

expected_output.error: wt.exe absent, fallback to powershell Start-Process

vectors.note: wt.exe missing is a fallback path, not a failure: ok can still be true once Start-Process succeeds; row kept as documentation of the fallback trigger condition
